spanish: Y degollarás el toro delante de Jehová, a abertura de tienda de reunión.

findings.issue: Unmarked supplied preposition «a» has no Hebrew token. פֶּתַח is a construct noun, so the locative preposition is not licensed.

notes: The remaining wording matches the tokens: weqatal 2ms, the bull, before Jehová, and the construct chain opening–tent–meeting.
